feeds.title: Parenting Hub
feeds.description: Parenting Hub is one of South Africa's largest online lifestyle magazines, targeted toward Parents. They understand that there are many aspects that encompass a Mother, Father, or Child and strive toward providing resources and services that accommodate this. Their content is aimed to inform and educate families on issues starting from pregnancy through to the challenges of the teen-age years.

feeds.title: Simply Delicious
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alida, mom of twins and creator of Simply Delicious. Simply Delicious is a general food and cooking blog. I like to experiment and try all different types of cuisine and I have a passion for food photography and styling.

feeds.title: Childpsych Blog
feeds.description: They are a group of Educational Psychologists commonly known as Child Psychologists from around South Africa, with the single common goal to provide relevant and up to date information about all aspects of being a child in South Africa. The primary focus is on the emotional well-being of children and how to ensure that children reach their full potential in all social and academic areas.

feeds.title: Fun Mamma SA
feeds.description: I'm Mamma Bear. Welcome to our blog where I write about parenting, life, and all the in-betweens as the mom of 7 children, from our home in Cape Town.

feeds.title: You, Baby and I
feeds.description: You, Baby and I is a South African blog written by Parenting and Lifestyle blogger based in Johannesburg, South Africa. Shan Vijendranath loves sharing personal stories, tips & views of her favorite brands with other moms.

feeds.title: Kaboutjie
feeds.description: I am Lynne. Mommy to a pigeon pair, blogger, and online marketer. Lover of chocolate, good books, and buckets of coffee. Just muddling my way through this parenting journey the best I can and sharing about it along the way!

feeds.title: Cape Town Insider
feeds.description: Cape Town Insider is a lifestyle blog edited by sisters Kath and Meg. Born out of a passion for writing and fun experiences, CTI is a collection of the things, places and occasions that we love. We blog primarily about products and brands that we have tested ourselves, as well as launches and events that we attend. We love new opportunities and are always up for an adventure.

feeds.title: se7en
feeds.description: We are an environmentally friendly, homeschooling family with se7en+1 kids and we blog from our seaside town, Fish Hoek, just south of Cape Town in South Africa. We are a lifestyle blog and we write about our life and times as a family with a gang of kids. We have blogged about parenting and things to do with small kids our memories have been stored on our blog and we hope you enjoy them.

feeds.title: A Zesty Life
feeds.description: Welcome to A Zesty Life. This is a South African lifestyle blog written, by me, for you, in the vibrant city of Johannesburg. I'm so excited that you stopped by. aZestyLife is about adding zest to your everyday life through decor, food, travels & other girly things like spa treatments.

feeds.title: Lovilee
feeds.description: The lovilee blog is a multi-award-winning WordPress blog filled with DIY ideas, free printables, home decor ideas, and party themes to inspire. We also offer a lifestyle section and provide the profile and expert advice articles on a regular basis. The blog is the creative outlet of blogger, Karen Kelly (Kari), wifey and mommy by day, and creative blogger by night, based in South Africa.

feeds.title: SA Mom Blogs
feeds.description: South African Mom Blogs is a space where brands can connect with the growing network of Mom Bloggers. They blog about everything from lifestyle, fashion, food and parenting.

feeds.title: One Messy Mama
feeds.description: One Messy Mama is A Family Lifestyle Blog. Connecting all the dots from parenting to marriage and self-love.

feeds.title: ChevsLife
feeds.description: Living & Parenting with Intent - Unmasking the Journey to Optimism and autism. Chivone is a single parent in the journey of motherhood.

feeds.title: Family Treasures Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Family Treasures Blog! We are so glad that you stopped by. We are a Cape Town Food, Craft, Travel, Fashion, Lifestyle, Health and family blog. Scratch that, it's just a family blog because being part of a family, especially a mom or dad, includes so much.

feeds.title: Sarah Graham Food Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest on what's happening in the world of Sarah Graham - South African cookbook author, food blogger and tv-chef.

feeds.title: 4aKid Blog
feeds.description: 4aKid is an award-winning online baby store, bringing you innovative products for babies and children, making life easier and simpler for parents. Our website offers you an all-round experience from amazing baby and kids products, parenting blogs, yummy recipes, baby competitions & reseller opportunities.

feeds.title: Smallberg Party of Four Blog
feeds.description: Smallberg Party of Four is a family and parenting lifestyle blog by Nadine Smallberg. It brings you the latest products for children and moms to help make life a little simpler.

feeds.title: Mama Magic Blog
feeds.description: Mama Magic is South Africa's biggest and best baby and parenting expo. Here, you will experience a great deal of entertainment and fun activities as well as it is an ideal opportunity for parents to gain knowledge about pregnancy, birth, and parenting.

feeds.title: Rattle & Mum
feeds.description: An award-winning parenting blog by Tanya Kovarsky on trends, fashion, tips, products, news, events, commentary, and giveaways.

feeds.title: Becoming you
feeds.description: A South African Lifestyle Blog, Travel Blog and Beauty Blog publishing daily information, inspiration and encouragement for women, especially moms created by Kathryn Rossiter, a South African blogger who writes daily about family, travel, health, fashion & beauty.

feeds.title: Healthy Vegetarian Foods
feeds.description: I am Usha. I am a full time mother of two kids. In 2011, my blog 'Healthy Vegetarian Foods' was born on the Food24.com website, and in August 2012, I was encouraged to start my own blog website, which is how Healthy Vegetarian Foods began.

feeds.title: The Milk Memoirs
feeds.description: One part chronicle, one part resource of all things birth, parenting, and family life with a good dose of fun, crafts & mommy realness.

feeds.title: Just A Mamma
feeds.description: This is a space for Mammas by a Mamma. Intended to inspire, motivate and be helpful. No judgement or expert advice - just gorgeous photo shoots, fun celebrations, great finds for mamma and baby, inspirational moms I have come across, places to go and vacations to have, as well as my own journey of motherhood and family life.

feeds.title: One Step At a Time
feeds.description: Blogging about the ups and downs of life with a toddler, in Johannesburg, SA.

feeds.title: The Mom Diaries
feeds.description: A personal blog about the ups and downs of raising two little boys and all the mess in between. Wife to a crazy DJ, mother to three of the cutest creatures alive, writer, decor enthusiast, wine drinker, over-thinker & lifestyle, and parenting blogger.

feeds.title: Hayley's Joys
feeds.description: I'm Hayley and welcome to my blog. You'll find lots of parenting chats which makes me a Mommy Blogger, but you'll also find some other things that inspire me and hopefully inspire you too!

feeds.title: Home With Mariette
feeds.description: South African interior designer, Mariëtte Sakelliou started Little Interiors in 2011, making the leap from corporate interiors to kids and baby interiors.Her passion for creating stylish spaces that promote growing and learning evolved into the development of the decor range, LittleME by Little Interiors as well as her decor & lifestyle blog.

feeds.title: Letters To My Wildling
feeds.description: I am just Monique, a 25 year old mom with a passion to write and most importantly - mother of the wildling - who embraced this exciting little adventure with my son called Life.

feeds.title: Keeping it Candid Blog
feeds.description: A South African Lifestyle, Beauty and Parenting Blog. I am Cisca, the creator behind, Its a Mom's Life. I became a first time Mom in 2017, to our son Hudson. Together our family grew from having two yorkies, Charzi and Minka to a little human that wanted constant cuddles and kisses. My blog gives authentic and raw accounts of trying to do it all. I have always been creative, and through my blog, I am able to share and review some great local and international brands.

feeds.title: Heart Mama Blog
feeds.description: Heart Mama is a blog by Jules who is a mum to 3 kids. She keeps blogging about the adventure of parenting & the joy of adoption in South Africa.

feeds.title: Tonic & Tiaras
feeds.description: Tonic and Tiara is a collection of thoughts and stories from the quarter life crisis of a coffee addicted mom of two from Benoni.

feeds.title: Rose & Thorns
feeds.description: Award-winning lifestyle & parenting blog full of real and raw moments. A journey through parenting, food, wine and life in the Mother City.

feeds.title: Pediatrics and Playdough
feeds.description: Pediatrics and Playdough is a blog about Travelling through Motherhood from a Pediatrician perspective.

feeds.title: Pretty Please Charlie
feeds.description: A South African Blog about Beauty, Parenting, Fashion & Lifestyle. My name is Charlene and welcome to Pretty Please Charlie. Here I share news and reviews of beauty products, toys, events, fashion and whatever else I feel may add value to your life.

feeds.title: The Bird and The Beard
feeds.description: First-time mom trying to muddle her way through parenthood, with the help of her beardy partner-in-crime.

feeds.title: One Modern Mom Blog
feeds.description: Motherhood is hard, and not one of us have the same story to tell. Celebrate each tiny victory of being a mom. One Modern Mom is a platform for moms of each walk of life. A place to educate moms on the best products for us as women and for your family.

feeds.title: MomTalk.co.za
feeds.description: South Africa Lifestyle and Mom blog, Mom Talk, has been built to encourage moms to be their best selves, empower women to embrace their dreams, and inspire moms toget serious about loving life!

feeds.title: Mom Says
feeds.description: After two years of blogging, Shanèy realized that You, Baby and I was more than just a blog. It became of tribe of moms who trusted each other's opinions. Towards the end of 2016, Shanèy saw this as an opportunity and decided to launch her startup MomSays.

feeds.title: BabyYumYum
feeds.description: BabyYumYum is a parenting portal for your pregnancy, baby and general child-rearing support needs. From morning sickness to nappy changes; first foods and first days at school, BabyYumYum offers expert advice as well as information on the latest products, lifestyle, and parenting trends.

feeds.title: Harassed Mom Blog
feeds.description: HarrassedMom - a harassed but happy mom parenting 4 children one day at a time. When I am not homeschooling I work with an awesome team of creatives helping brands manage their online presence.

feeds.title: My Spreadsheet Brain
feeds.description: My Spreadsheet Brain focuses on parenting, marriage, and faith. Creator and editor, Luchae Williams, is a young mom of 4 (soon to be 5!), wife to 1, and co-host of the #ECMeetUp - an annual bloggers conference held in the Eastern Cape of South Africa.

feeds.title: An Ordinary Gal
feeds.description: An Ordinary Gal is a beauty, parenting and book review blog that seeks to be your one stop blog for practical beauty tips and Parenting Blog

feeds.title: Mommy Mall
feeds.description: Mommy Mall South Africa is a collective that promotes mother owned businesses in such a manner that it frees up time for mothers to do more of the things they love and spend more time with their children.

feeds.title: Sweet Baby Journal
feeds.description: I am Ruvimbo. Follow me on my pregnancy journey with inspiration, tips and product reviews. My blog filters and orders the information important to us here in South Africa, taking note of great products, documenting our DIY projects and our small family living each day to the fullest! Most importantly, it reminds you to be kind to yourself as you go on this journey!

feeds.title: Curlyheads & Dimples
feeds.description: I am Juwayra. Curlyheads and Dimples is where I blog about everything and anything about my kids, my natural hair journey, what I get up to in the kitchen, etc.

feeds.title: Me Becoming Mom
feeds.description: I am Teniel. Me Becoming Mom is a blog about my pregnancy and motherhood and sharing my experience through tips, articles, and poetry.
